pressures.condition: files written decades ago must be readable byte-for-byte by programs written today; the layout is the contract and no schema exists outside the programs
pressures.resource_or_constraint: no runtime type information in the file
pressures.failure_condition: a misread field (record: mis-edited amount)
pressures.world_punishes: implicit layouts; encodings that change with the machine
pressures.world_rewards: the layout written in the program, byte-exact, with the encoding named per field
pressures.observable_consequence: the record's observation: packed-decimal amounts format correctly under GnuCOBOL while EBCDIC text does not -- the layout survived, the character set did not
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a self-describing format (not available to the 1960s world)
pressures.cheat_control: a program given the layout as data (a copybook) must read the file; if the world rewards it equally to one that guesses the layout from the bytes, format longevity is not being measured

pressures.source_evidence: record failure condition; COMPUTE / edited pictures
pressures.condition: every amount is a decimal with a fixed scale; rounding and truncation are legally specified; the output is a printed report that an auditor reads
pressures.failure_condition: a cent of drift; a truncated total
pressures.world_rewards: declared-scale decimal arithmetic and edited output
pressures.observable_consequence: totals on the report vs a hand sum of the file
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: integers in cents (correct; the world may allow it)
pressures.cheat_control: corrupt one COMP-3 field (the record's entry point): the report must show the corruption, not hide it

pressures.source_evidence: record pressure / failure; ticket.h vs mcs.h
pressures.condition: mutual exclusion must be cheap when uncontended and must not collapse when N cores spin; the cost of a cache-line transfer dwarfs the critical section
pressures.resource_or_constraint: cache coherence traffic; no OS involvement
pressures.failure_condition: a convoy of spinning threads starving the holder (record)
pressures.world_punishes: all waiters spinning on the same line; retrying without waiting
pressures.world_rewards: waiting where nobody else writes (per-node spinning), or waiting longer each time (backoff), while keeping order
pressures.observable_consequence: acquisitions per second vs thread count > core count (the record's entry point)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: an OS mutex (sleeps; the world must charge the syscall)
pressures.cheat_control: a lock that knows the next holder in advance (a scheduler oracle) must beat every spinlock; if the world's benchmark cannot separate ticket from MCS at 2x oversubscription, it is not measuring the pressure
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: building blocks for lock-free and low-latency systems

pressures.condition: lock-free readers hold no lock, so a writer cannot know who still references a node it unlinked
pressures.resource_or_constraint: no reference counts on the read path (they would be contended writes)
pressures.failure_condition: use-after-free (record)
pressures.world_rewards: deferring frees behind a global notion of 'all readers have moved on' (epochs) or per-reader announcements (hazard pointers)
pressures.observable_consequence: ASan-clean runs under churn; reclamation latency vs reader stall
pressures.vacuity_condition: no concurrent readers, or a garbage collector
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: never free (memory; the world must charge it)
pressures.cheat_control: a freer told exactly when the last reader leaves must reclaim immediately with zero faults; if the world scores never-free equally, memory is not charged

pressures.condition: different architectures give different guarantees; a primitive correct on x86 is wrong on ARM without fences
pressures.failure_condition: torn reads, lost updates (record)
pressures.world_rewards: explicit acquire/release/lock/unlock fences at the primitive layer
pressures.observable_consequence: the ck_pr_fence_* calls in every organ
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: full fences everywhere (slow)
pressures.cheat_control: N/A on x86 hardware (the pressure is invisible there); a world on a weak-memory machine is required

pressures.source_evidence: mars.py step / enqueue / DAT; record example (Imp vs Dwarf)
pressures.condition: every program's code is data in the same circular memory; any instruction can write anywhere (within the reach limit); a program dies when all its processes execute a DAT; turns alternate one instruction per program
pressures.resource_or_constraint: 8000 cells; one instruction per turn; max_processes
pressures.failure_condition: being overwritten with DAT before overwriting the opponent
pressures.world_punishes: staying still (bombable), being large (findable), spending turns on non-lethal work
pressures.world_rewards: self-copying / self-moving code (the Imp), sparse bombing (the Dwarf), process splitting to survive partial damage
pressures.observable_consequence: which warrior survives after N cycles, over many random placements
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: none obvious inside the rules; the rules themselves (read/write limits, process cap) are the knobs
pressures.cheat_control: a warrior told the opponent's placement must win nearly always; if random placement is not enforced, the world rewards fixed-address bombs
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: a programming game (Dewdney 1984); later, an artificial-life substrate

pressures.condition: with pre-decrement and post-increment operand modes one instruction can advance a pointer and act through it; program length is a liability (pressure 1)
pressures.failure_condition: long, slow warriors
pressures.world_punishes: explicit loop counters and pointer updates
pressures.world_rewards: folding the pointer update into the operand fetch
pressures.observable_consequence: warrior length vs win rate
pressures.vacuity_condition: no reach limit and no bombing (length is free)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: none
pressures.cheat_control: N/A

pressures.condition: the secret is a fixed number of bits; the cost of trying them all falls every year; the transform itself has no known shortcut
pressures.resource_or_constraint: key length fixed by the standard; adversary compute
pressures.failure_condition: exhaustive search becomes affordable (1998: days)
pressures.world_punishes: a parameter frozen in a document
pressures.world_rewards: nothing inside the machinery -- the fix was a new standard
pressures.observable_consequence: withdrawal of the standard; the fossil still round-trips
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: none
pressures.cheat_control: N/A
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: confidentiality of 64-bit blocks under a shared key

pressures.condition: every output bit must depend non-linearly on every input and key bit, on 1977 hardware
pressures.failure_condition: a linear or local dependency exposes the key from few plaintexts
pressures.world_rewards: a non-linear step and a rewiring step per round, repeated
pressures.observable_consequence: avalanche after few rounds (NOT measured here; record names it as the behavioural entry point)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a random-looking but linear map
pressures.cheat_control: a round-count sweep measuring output-bit flip fraction per input-bit flip (planned, not run)

pressures.condition: work runs for hours on machines that fail or are reclaimed; the program has no save/restore of its own and cannot be modified
pressures.failure_condition: hours lost at a crash; or a restart that silently diverges (record)
pressures.world_punishes: recomputation from zero; divergence after restore
pressures.world_rewards: capturing all state that determines the future and reinstating it exactly
pressures.observable_consequence: the record's oracle: a counter resumes at the checkpointed value, not zero
pressures.vacuity_condition: no failures; or programs that already checkpoint themselves
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: rerun from the start (correct, pays the full cost); the world must charge for lost work
pressures.cheat_control: a program that persists its own counter to a file must pass the oracle without DMTCP; if the world rewards it equally, the world measures persistence, not transparency
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: fault tolerance for unmodified programs

pressures.condition: identifiers the program holds (pids, tids, fds, addresses, ports) are assigned by the OS and differ in the new incarnation while the program's memory still holds the old ones
pressures.resource_or_constraint: OS naming is not under the program's control
pressures.failure_condition: a restored program signals the wrong pid, writes to a closed fd, connects to a dead address
pressures.world_rewards: an indirection layer that owns the names the program sees and remaps them
pressures.observable_consequence: post-restart calls succeed or fail
pressures.vacuity_condition: an OS that preserves ids across restart (none does)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: never use ids (impossible for real programs)
pressures.cheat_control: a program that only ever uses names DMTCP virtualises must restart cleanly; one that smuggles a raw pid through shared memory must fail -- the world can tell

pressures.condition: bytes in flight live in the kernel (socket buffers) and in peers, invisible to a memory image
pressures.resource_or_constraint: the process boundary is narrower than the computation's state
pressures.failure_condition: a restart that loses or duplicates in-flight messages
pressures.world_rewards: a protocol that flushes external state into the process (cookie-drain) and replays it after
pressures.observable_consequence: message counts before and after restart
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: quiesce the whole application first (needs cooperation the pressure forbids)
pressures.cheat_control: a pair of processes given a shared flush-and-replay must show byte-identical streams across restart

pressures.condition: a checkpoint of a distributed computation is only useful if no message is recorded as received but not sent; processes have no shared clock
pressures.failure_condition: orphan / lost messages on restart
pressures.world_rewards: a barrier protocol (a coordinator counting arrivals, or its distributed equivalent)
pressures.observable_consequence: consistency of the restored fleet
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: stop the world by an external signal (works if all processes are on one host)
pressures.cheat_control: a fleet with a known-consistent cut injected must restart cleanly; a fleet snapshotted at random times must sometimes fail -- if it never does, the world is not exercising the pressure

pressures.condition: the code must run on many machines whose floating-point base, precision and exponent range differ and are not queryable
pressures.failure_condition: a tolerance right for one machine is wrong for another: false convergence or non-termination
pressures.world_rewards: letting the arithmetic itself decide (equality tests, probing 4/3, ratio-only hypotenuse)
pressures.observable_consequence: three organs (deflate test, pythag, epslon) exist only because of this
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: double everything
pressures.cheat_control: run under x87 extended precision vs SSE and count iterations (not run)
pressures.cost_class: a few extra operations per test

pressures.condition: eigenvalues close together slow the shifted iteration and make deflation ambiguous
pressures.failure_condition: 30 iterations exceeded (ierr)
pressures.world_rewards: a good shift and a deflation test that recognises decoupling
pressures.observable_consequence: ierr path with partial results
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: none
pressures.cheat_control: Techne's entry point: 'feed matrices with clustered or degenerate eigenvalues' (not run)

pressures.condition: the machine has a word list and patterns; the human supplies all meaning; the reply must reflect the input back in a form that invites the next turn
pressures.resource_or_constraint: 1966 memory (a few hundred rules); no parsing beyond keywords
pressures.failure_condition: a turn no rule covers -> canned deflection; the illusion breaks (record)
pressures.world_punishes: rules that do not cover the input distribution
pressures.world_rewards: reflection (pronoun swap + echo), a precedence that answers the most specific keyword, and a delayed memory that simulates continuity
pressures.observable_consequence: the CACM 1966 conversation reproduced exactly (the record's oracle); the rate of fallback replies on new inputs
pressures.vacuity_condition: a cooperative human who only uses scripted keywords
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a fixed list of open questions (no reflection; a world that measures only turn-taking rewards it)
pressures.cheat_control: an engine that echoes the input verbatim with pronouns swapped must score below the scripted one on any measure of believability; if the world cannot tell them apart, it measures echo, not the script
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: demonstrate (and, per Weizenbaum, debunk) natural-language understanding

pressures.source_evidence: record pressure / failure; nut00a loop order; the date convention
pressures.condition: a milliarcsecond error misplaces catalogue stars; the quantities span 2.4 million days and 1e-10 radians in the same computation
pressures.resource_or_constraint: IEEE double; the ordering of floating-point sums
pressures.failure_condition: a term off by 1e-9 (record)
pressures.world_punishes: single-number dates; summing large terms first; truncated series
pressures.world_rewards: split representations, smallest-first summation, long series with a published reference
pressures.observable_consequence: make check: 247 routines within tolerance of reference values
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: extended precision arithmetic (slower; the world may allow it)
pressures.cheat_control: a routine with the reference values compiled in must pass; if it passes with a perturbed constant (the record's entry point), the tolerance is too loose -- the fossil's own validation is the cheat control's mirror
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: fundamental astronomy for catalogues and observatories

pressures.condition: the IAU replaces precession/nutation models every decade; results computed under an old model must remain reproducible and comparable
pressures.failure_condition: silent drift when a model is swapped
pressures.world_rewards: coexisting versioned routines with the model in the name (nut80 / nut00a / nut06a)
pressures.observable_consequence: the routine list; the same transform under two models differs by a known amount
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: none
pressures.cheat_control: N/A

pressures.condition: leap seconds are decided by the IERS; code compiled before the decision cannot know it; a result past the table's horizon is quietly wrong
pressures.failure_condition: wrong TAI - UTC after the horizon
pressures.world_rewards: a table with a run-time extension hook and a dated validity warning
pressures.observable_consequence: eraDat's status code past IYV + 5
pressures.vacuity_condition: a world with no leap seconds
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: refuse dates past the horizon (the world may reward or punish this)
pressures.cheat_control: N/A

pressures.condition: the discrete Fourier transform is an N x N matrix product; N in the thousands must run on machines where N^2 flops and an N x N table are unaffordable
pressures.resource_or_constraint: flops and memory of the era; single precision
pressures.failure_condition: N^2 cost; or an N restricted to powers of two
pressures.world_punishes: direct evaluation; a transform that only accepts 2^k
pressures.world_rewards: factoring the index set and reusing sub-transforms (the same structure whatever the factors)
pressures.observable_consequence: runtime vs N and vs the factorisation of N (the doc's 'most efficient when n is a product of small primes')
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: restrict N to 2^k (the world must include awkward N)
pressures.cheat_control: a transform given a precomputed N x N matrix must match to single precision and cost N^2; if the world scores it equal, cost is not being charged
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: spectral analysis / PDE solvers (Swarztrauber's use)

pressures.condition: applications need several related transforms; each written from scratch multiplies the code and the error surface
pressures.failure_condition: divergent implementations of the same butterflies
pressures.world_rewards: symmetry-exploiting pre/post processing around one kernel
pressures.observable_consequence: the wrapper files call RFFTF/RFFTB and never a pass directly
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: none
pressures.cheat_control: N/A

pressures.condition: one shared resource; two classes of users; the numerous class can share it among themselves, the rare class needs it alone; the numerous class re-arrives continuously
pressures.resource_or_constraint: exclusive access for the rare class
pressures.failure_condition: the rare class never obtains access while the numerous class keeps arriving
pressures.world_punishes: updates that never land; unbounded wait for the rare class
pressures.world_rewards: the numerous class if admitted freely (throughput), the rare class if admitted at all
pressures.observable_consequence: Techne run: 8 continuous readers, 3 s: writer got in ONCE under the default policy
pressures.vacuity_condition: no writer, or readers that pause
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: make everyone exclusive (kills the reader throughput the lock exists for)
pressures.cheat_control: measure BOTH classes' acquisition counts, not writer alone (the same run shows reader acquisitions fall 9x when writers are preferred)
pressures.cost_class: throughput of the dominant class traded for progress of the rare class
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: let many threads read a structure concurrently while writers update it safely

pressures.condition: a synchronisation object may be freed by its owner the instant no thread holds or will acquire it, yet a releasing thread may still owe wake-ups to sleepers
pressures.failure_condition: a wake-up touches freed memory
pressures.world_rewards: a hand-over protocol whose final store is the last touch
pressures.observable_consequence: the two-step phase flip + separate wait word in the source
pressures.vacuity_condition: lock lifetime managed elsewhere (never destroyed under contention)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: never free locks
pressures.cheat_control: UNKNOWN (not measurable from the harness)
pressures.cost_class: an extra store and a discipline on waiters
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: POSIX conformance of destruction semantics

pressures.condition: waking sleepers costs a kernel transition; most releases have no sleepers
pressures.failure_condition: a release always pays the syscall
pressures.world_rewards: knowing whether anyone sleeps before calling
pressures.observable_consequence: FUTEX_USED bit in two wait words
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: never wake (deadlock)
pressures.cheat_control: count syscalls per release with and without sleepers (not run)

pressures.condition: redundancy is mostly local repeats of short strings; the encoder may look back a bounded distance and spend bounded work per byte; ratio and speed trade against each other
pressures.resource_or_constraint: 32 KB window; a chain-length budget; 1993 memory
pressures.failure_condition: too slow to be usable, or a ratio no better than compress
pressures.world_rewards: hashing to candidates, bounded chain walks, and a one-byte deferral that recovers most of the greedy loss
pressures.observable_consequence: ratio vs time across the level table (the record's entry point)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: store only (level 0)
pressures.cheat_control: an encoder given the optimal parse must beat level 9's ratio; if the world scores it equal, ratio resolution is too coarse
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: a compressor free of the LZW patent

pressures.source_evidence: record failure condition; the three block types
pressures.condition: every archive ever written must decode forever; the encoder may improve, the bitstream may not
pressures.failure_condition: orphaned archives (record)
pressures.world_rewards: a format whose flexibility (dynamic trees, stored blocks) lets encoders improve without touching the decoder
pressures.observable_consequence: 1993 archives decoded by 2025 decoders
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: none
pressures.cheat_control: N/A

pressures.condition: LZW (compress) is encumbered; the design must avoid its mechanism while beating it
pressures.failure_condition: distribution stopped (record)
pressures.world_rewards: LZ77 pointer-based matching plus Huffman coding
pressures.observable_consequence: the existence of unlzw.c beside deflate.c: decode the rival, never encode it
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: none
pressures.cheat_control: N/A

pressures.condition: nodes join, leave and crash; messages are lost; no node may pay more than a constant per round; a false 'dead' evicts a healthy node and a slow 'dead' leaves a ghost
pressures.resource_or_constraint: O(1) messages per node per period; UDP loss; clock-free
pressures.failure_condition: false positives from a slow prober or a lossy link; unbounded detection time
pressures.world_punishes: heartbeats to everyone (O(n^2)); trusting one missed ack
pressures.world_rewards: random probing with indirect confirmation, epidemic spread with a log(n) retransmit budget, and evidence-weighted suspicion timers
pressures.observable_consequence: the record's entry point: shrink ProbeTimeout / SuspicionMult and count false positives; detection time vs cluster size
pressures.vacuity_condition: a reliable network with few nodes
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a central registry (forbidden by the design); the world must remove the coordinator
pressures.cheat_control: a detector told which nodes are truly dead must have zero false positives and minimal delay; if the world cannot separate it from SWIM under injected loss, loss is not being injected
pressures.cost_class: CPU-scale (in-process cluster over loopback, as the tests do)
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: cluster membership for Consul / Nomad / Serf

pressures.condition: an overloaded or partitioned prober sees everyone fail; declaring them all dead is exactly wrong
pressures.failure_condition: a sick node evicting the healthy cluster
pressures.world_rewards: a local health score that slows the prober's own clocks and a suspicion timer that wants independent confirmation
pressures.observable_consequence: false positive rate with one degraded node (Lifeguard's experiment)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a very long timeout (slow detection; the world must charge delay)
pressures.cheat_control: a prober told its own health must outperform awareness scoring; if it does not, the world's degradation is not local

pressures.condition: memories are addressed by content: a partial or noisy pattern must fall to the complete one by local dynamics alone
pressures.resource_or_constraint: N^2 weights for ~0.14 N patterns; no external comparison
pressures.failure_condition: convergence to a spurious attractor (record)
pressures.world_punishes: storing correlated or too many patterns; cues beyond the basin
pressures.world_rewards: a dynamics whose fixed points are the stored patterns and whose basins are wide
pressures.observable_consequence: recall accuracy vs corruption level and vs pattern count (the record's entry point)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: nearest-neighbour lookup over the stored list (exact, uses an index the pressure forbids)
pressures.cheat_control: a recaller given the stored list must recover every pattern within its Hamming basin; if the world does not distinguish it from Hebbian recall above capacity, capacity is not being tested

pressures.condition: a spinning disk (2011) writes sequentially 100x faster than randomly; a key-value store receives random keys; reads must not degrade into scanning every file
pressures.resource_or_constraint: disk seek cost; write amplification budget
pressures.failure_condition: either random-write throughput collapses or reads touch unbounded files
pressures.world_punishes: in-place trees on disk (random writes); unbounded file counts
pressures.world_rewards: append-only files merged in the background under a size invariant per level
pressures.observable_consequence: write throughput vs read latency vs write_buffer_size (the record's entry point)
pressures.vacuity_condition: a random-access medium with no seek cost
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a log with no compaction (reads scan; the world must charge reads)
pressures.cheat_control: a store given the final key set in advance (one sorted file) must show the best reads and no compaction cost; if the world does not distinguish it from a live LSM, background work is not being charged
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: an embedded ordered key-value store (Google, 2011)

pressures.condition: the process may die after acknowledging a write; the in-memory table is gone; the on-disk tables were not yet updated
pressures.resource_or_constraint: one fsync per group at most
pressures.failure_condition: acknowledged keys missing after reopen (the record's entry point)
pressures.world_rewards: a CRC-framed log written first and replayed on open, with batching to amortise the sync
pressures.observable_consequence: keys present after an unclean close
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: fsync every write (slow; the world must charge latency)
pressures.cheat_control: a store told the crash instant must lose exactly the unacknowledged writes; if the world does not inject the crash between AddRecord and InsertInto, it is not testing the log

pressures.condition: flushes and merges run on one background thread; writes arrive at any rate; memory for the memtable and the level-0 file count are bounded
pressures.resource_or_constraint: one background thread; write_buffer_size; kL0 triggers
pressures.failure_condition: unbounded memtables or level-0 files; or writes stalled for seconds
pressures.world_rewards: graded back-pressure (a 1 ms delay before a stop) keyed to the backlog
pressures.observable_consequence: write latency distribution under a burst
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: unbounded memory
pressures.cheat_control: a store with an infinitely fast compactor must never stall; if the world's write rate never triggers the slowdown, the mechanism is untested

pressures.source_evidence: the whole library; metrics.c models the channel
pressures.condition: a channel flips or perturbs each transmitted symbol independently with some probability; the receiver sees only the corrupted sequence and knows the code; redundancy costs bandwidth so it is fixed in advance
pressures.failure_condition: bit/frame error rate above what the application tolerates at the operating SNR
pressures.world_punishes: decoding that ignores soft information or the code's structure
pressures.world_rewards: exploiting structure (trellis or algebra) to reach the code's correction capacity
pressures.observable_consequence: BER vs Eb/No curves (vtest27's output)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: majority vote on repetition (works, far from capacity); a world must charge for redundancy
pressures.cheat_control: a decoder given the transmitted bits must show BER 0; a world that scores it equal to a real decoder at high noise is not measuring correction
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: deliver bits over a noisy link (satellite, amateur radio)

pressures.condition: frames are usually clean and occasionally very noisy; a decoder with fixed cost pays the worst case always, one with variable cost pays for the noise it meets but may not finish
pressures.failure_condition: timeout on a noisy frame (Fano) versus a state count that cannot be afforded at all (Viterbi at K=32)
pressures.world_punishes: fixed cost when noise is rare; unbounded cost when noise is common
pressures.world_rewards: an early-exit search whose failure is detectable and cheap to fall back from
pressures.observable_consequence: the distribution of cycles per frame; timeout rate vs SNR
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: always run the exhaustive decoder (only possible for short constraint lengths)
pressures.cheat_control: a search told the true path must use ~1 cycle per bit; if the world does not reward that, effort is not being measured
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: same, at long constraint length

pressures.source_evidence: record: RS decoder present beside Viterbi; CCSDS concatenation files
pressures.condition: corruption hits runs of bits (fading, a scratched medium), so a bit-level code sees many errors in one place while a symbol-level code sees few corrupted symbols
pressures.failure_condition: bit-level decoders fail on bursts they could survive if spread
pressures.world_punishes: treating burst errors as independent bit errors
pressures.world_rewards: grouping bits into symbols (RS) or spreading errors (an interleaver -- NOT in this body)
pressures.observable_consequence: frame error rate under burst vs random noise at equal bit-error rate
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: none obvious
pressures.cheat_control: a decoder told the burst boundaries must correct up to nroots/2 symbol errors regardless of bit count

pressures.condition: many senders share a link whose only feedback is a dropped packet, observed one round trip late; over-sending collapses everyone's useful throughput
pressures.resource_or_constraint: bottleneck capacity; one RTT of delay before any signal
pressures.failure_condition: congestion collapse (record: 1986)
pressures.world_punishes: sending more than the link drains for longer than the buffer hides
pressures.world_rewards: backing off on a loss and re-growing at a rate that neither idles the link nor starves neighbours
pressures.observable_consequence: throughput per flow, loss rate, convergence time between flows
pressures.vacuity_condition: a single sender on an uncontended link; or a link that never drops
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: send at a fixed low rate (safe, wastes the link); a world must reward utilisation AND punish loss
pressures.cheat_control: a sender that reads the bottleneck capacity directly from the world must reach the utilisation that the loss-signal-only sender can only approach; if it cannot, the world does not reward the capability
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: transmit a byte stream reliably

pressures.condition: the bottleneck buffer holds many seconds of data, so loss arrives long after queueing delay has grown; a loss-driven sender fills the buffer and every flow's latency rises
pressures.failure_condition: bufferbloat: throughput fine, latency ruined
pressures.world_rewards: an estimate of the pipe (rate and floor delay) used instead of waiting for loss
pressures.observable_consequence: queueing delay under load; min_rtt drift
pressures.vacuity_condition: shallow buffers (loss and delay rise together)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a fixed low rate; a sender that never probes for more
pressures.cheat_control: a sender given the true bandwidth and propagation delay must show low delay at full utilisation in the world; otherwise the world's reward is not measuring the capability

pressures.condition: a middlebox admits traffic at a fixed long-term rate and drops bursts above it; a sender that probes upward is punished with a burst of loss every probe
pressures.resource_or_constraint: an external rate cap invisible except through loss timing
pressures.failure_condition: repeated loss bursts each probe cycle; throughput well below the cap
pressures.world_rewards: inferring the cap from two agreeing loss-bounded intervals and holding at it
pressures.observable_consequence: loss rate vs sending rate shows a knee at the cap
pressures.vacuity_condition: no enforcer, or an enforcer with a bucket larger than the probe
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a sender that halves on every loss (Reno) finds a rate below the cap but oscillates; the world must reward holding AT the cap
pressures.cheat_control: a sender told the cap must hold it with near-zero loss; if the world does not distinguish that from the oscillating sender, the pressure is not being measured

pressures.source_evidence: tcp_bbr.c 816-870 comments; tcp_cubic.c 366-384 (the same problem patched in HyStart)
pressures.condition: the return path delivers acknowledgements in bursts (link-layer aggregation), so per-ACK rate and delay samples misrepresent the forward path and a window sized to the true BDP idles between bursts
pressures.failure_condition: underutilisation despite a correct rate estimate
pressures.world_punishes: a window with no allowance for feedback silence
pressures.world_rewards: estimating the excess acked beyond the expected and provisioning for it
pressures.observable_consequence: throughput gap that closes when cwnd is padded
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: an unbounded cwnd (fills buffers; punished by the bufferbloat pressure)
pressures.cheat_control: a sender with the aggregation size given must reach full throughput

pressures.condition: the process or host can die between any two writes; the medium may tear a multi-page write; on reopen there is no log to replay
pressures.failure_condition: a torn write corrupts the tree (record)
pressures.world_punishes: in-place modification of reachable pages; a root pointer updated before its pages are durable
pressures.world_rewards: never overwriting reachable state and switching the root atomically after a sync
pressures.observable_consequence: the record's oracle after a kill between put and commit
pressures.vacuity_condition: no crashes; or a medium with atomic multi-page writes
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: rewrite the whole file on every commit (correct, O(size))
pressures.cheat_control: a store told when the crash will happen must always recover; if the world scores it no better than a store that corrupts on a torn meta, the world is not injecting crashes at the right instants

pressures.condition: many processes read while one writes; reads must be consistent snapshots and must not slow the writer or each other
pressures.resource_or_constraint: shared memory; no coordination on the read path
pressures.failure_condition: a reader observes a page mid-change (record) or waits on the writer
pressures.world_punishes: locks on the read path; in-place writes
pressures.world_rewards: immutable versions plus a cheap registration of which version each reader holds
pressures.observable_consequence: read throughput under a concurrent writer; snapshot consistency checks
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a global lock (consistent, serialised); the world must reward concurrency
pressures.cheat_control: a reader given a private frozen copy must see a consistent snapshot; a world that does not detect torn reads on the naive store is not measuring isolation

pressures.condition: copy-on-write leaves the old page behind; without reclamation the file grows without bound; with premature reclamation a reader dereferences reused bytes
pressures.failure_condition: unbounded growth (long reader) or corruption (early reuse)
pressures.world_rewards: a version-stamped free list gated by the oldest live snapshot
pressures.observable_consequence: file size vs reader lifetime distribution
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: never free (bounded workloads only)
pressures.cheat_control: a store told every reader's exit time exactly must reclaim eagerly and never corrupt; if the world rewards a never-free store equally on a long run, it is not charging for space

pressures.condition: a decision tree of 2^n leaves; a failed branch's cause usually involves few variables and recurs elsewhere in the tree
pressures.failure_condition: re-exploring the same dead sub-space; or drowning in remembered clauses
pressures.world_punishes: forgetting why a branch failed; keeping everything
pressures.world_rewards: extracting a small reason, jumping back past irrelevant decisions, and forgetting reasons that stop being used
pressures.observable_consequence: conflicts / decisions / propagations per instance (the record's cross-solver comparison)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a lookup table of solved instances (the world must present unseen instances)
pressures.cheat_control: a solver given the satisfying assignment must finish with zero conflicts; one given the refutation clauses must finish near-instantly; if the world cannot tell, it is not measuring search

pressures.condition: no static measure of a variable predicts where conflicts will come from; the search's own recent conflicts are the only signal, and it drifts
pressures.failure_condition: a stale order that keeps choosing variables irrelevant to the current conflicts
pressures.world_punishes: static orders; orders that never forget
pressures.world_rewards: an order driven by recent conflict participation with geometric forgetting
pressures.observable_consequence: decisions to solution with var_decay = 0.95 vs a static order (var_decay < 0 in this body)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: random order with restarts
pressures.cheat_control: a heuristic told the variables of the final refutation must beat VSIDS; if it does not, the world's instances do not reward focus

pressures.condition: data arrive as vectors with no labels and no target; a fixed small set of prototypes must cover them so that similar inputs land on nearby prototypes
pressures.resource_or_constraint: x*y prototypes, far fewer than samples; no supervisory signal
pressures.failure_condition: prototypes collapse onto one region (dead cells) or the grid folds (twisted map)
pressures.world_punishes: high reconstruction distance; neighbours on the grid that are far in input space
pressures.world_rewards: low quantisation error AND low topographic error together
pressures.observable_consequence: quantization_error and topographic_error (the fossil's own instruments)
pressures.vacuity_condition: as many prototypes as samples (each sample gets its own cell)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: k-means minimises quantisation error alone; a world that rewards only that does not need the lattice
pressures.cheat_control: a codebook built from the true cluster centres with a random grid assignment must score well on quantisation and badly on topography; if the world cannot tell it from a trained map, it is not measuring organisation
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: visualise / cluster high-dimensional data on a 2-D sheet

pressures.condition: the process has two regimes (coarse ordering, fine convergence) and no observable tells it which one it is in; the only control is a decay schedule against a budget known in advance
pressures.failure_condition: too fast a decay freezes a twisted map; too slow a decay never converges
pressures.world_punishes: schedules mismatched to the data's structure
pressures.world_rewards: a schedule (or a self-measured proxy) that spends the budget on ordering first
pressures.observable_consequence: final topographic error as a function of the decay law
pressures.vacuity_condition: a budget so large that any decay works
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: run forever; a world must charge for iterations
pressures.cheat_control: a run given the ordering/convergence boundary as an oracle must beat every fixed schedule; otherwise the world's reward does not depend on the schedule

pressures.condition: the mapping from regressor to target is unknown and changes over time; each sample arrives once; the estimate must move enough to follow and little enough not to chase noise
pressures.resource_or_constraint: one pass; O(n) or O(n^2) per sample; a step-size constant chosen blind
pressures.failure_condition: divergence (step too large) or lag (step too small) -- the record's failure condition
pressures.world_punishes: a fixed step for a non-stationary plant
pressures.world_rewards: a step that reads the input scale and the recent error correlation
pressures.observable_consequence: tap error vs time across a plant switch (the record's entry point)
pressures.vacuity_condition: a stationary plant with unlimited samples (any small step wins)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: batch least squares on all data (correct, not online; the world must forbid revisiting)
pressures.cheat_control: a filter told the plant's switch times and true taps must show zero error after each switch; if the world scores it equal to LMS at a mu near the stability bound, tracking is not being measured
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: system identification, echo cancellation, equalisation

pressures.condition: occasional huge errors (impulsive noise) dominate a squared-error gradient and throw the weights
pressures.resource_or_constraint: no knowledge of which samples are outliers
pressures.failure_condition: weights jump on each impulse
pressures.world_rewards: bounded error nonlinearities (sign, tanh, correntropy kernels)
pressures.observable_consequence: tap error under Gaussian vs impulsive noise for LMS vs SSLMS/LLNCOSH/GMCC
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: clip the error (a crude f(e); the world should allow it)
pressures.cheat_control: a filter told which samples are impulses and skipping them must beat every f(e); if not, the world's noise is not impulsive

pressures.condition: regressor components are correlated; the error surface is a narrow valley; a first-order step converges at the rate of the smallest eigenvalue
pressures.failure_condition: slow convergence on coloured input
pressures.world_rewards: whitening (RLS) or projection onto recent inputs (AP), paid in compute
pressures.observable_consequence: convergence time vs input eigenvalue spread for LMS vs RLS vs AP
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: pre-whiten offline (needs the statistics the pressure hides)
pressures.cheat_control: a filter given the true autocorrelation must converge in ~n steps; if the world cannot separate it from LMS, the input is white

pressures.condition: several states influence each other; the actuator has a cost; a gain that is too aggressive saturates or destabilises, too timid leaves error
pressures.failure_condition: divergence / a crash (record)
pressures.world_punishes: gains chosen by hand per loop; ignoring coupling
pressures.world_rewards: a gain from a quadratic cost solved over the whole coupled model
pressures.observable_consequence: the closed-loop trajectory to the origin under Q/R variations and disturbances (the record's entry point)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a huge gain (fast, saturates; the world must bound effort)
pressures.cheat_control: a controller given the disturbance in advance must beat LQR on the cost; if the world's cost cannot separate them, effort or error is not being charged
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: control system design and analysis (a MATLAB Control Toolbox clone)

pressures.condition: design methods want state space; classical analysis wants transfer functions; measurements come as frequency data; conversions must agree and carry the sample time
pressures.failure_condition: a conversion that silently changes the system (ill-conditioned tf2ss)
pressures.world_rewards: interconvertible objects with a shared timebase check
pressures.observable_consequence: round-trip ss -> tf -> ss agreement
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: none
pressures.cheat_control: N/A

pressures.source_evidence: record pressure / failure; the mutation menu
pressures.condition: a target rejects most random bytes at the first check; the fuzzer sees nothing from the target (no crash feedback, no coverage) and must still produce inputs that reach deep code
pressures.resource_or_constraint: no target feedback; a fixed menu of edits
pressures.failure_condition: all cases rejected at the first byte (record)
pressures.world_rewards: edits at the representation level the target parses (lines, trees, strings, numbers) and a menu wide enough that some edit applies
pressures.observable_consequence: how far into cjson's parser the cases get (record entry point: pipe into cjson under ASan)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: replay a corpus of known crashes (the world must present a new target)
pressures.cheat_control: a mutator given the target's grammar must reach deeper than every menu item; if the world scores it equal to byte flips, depth is not being measured

pressures.source_evidence: the rs threading in every function
pressures.condition: a found bug is worthless unless the input can be regenerated; every random choice must derive from one seed and nothing else (no time, no I/O order)
pressures.failure_condition: non-reproducible cases (record)
pressures.world_rewards: threading one random state through every decision
pressures.observable_consequence: byte-identical output for the same seed and input
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: log every output (space; the world must charge for it)
pressures.cheat_control: N/A

pressures.condition: some operators never apply to this input and some always change it; the only observable is whether the output differs; the choice must not starve rare operators nor waste draws on inapplicable ones
pressures.failure_condition: repeatedly drawing an operator that cannot apply
pressures.world_rewards: a self-scoring scheduler with a floor (min-score 2) so nothing starves
pressures.observable_consequence: the 'used <name>' trace distribution on stderr
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: round robin
pressures.cheat_control: a scheduler told which operators apply must waste zero draws; if the world scores it equal to uniform, applicability is not being charged

pressures.condition: the same pressure recorded on libfec-karn: symbols are corrupted independently; 2tt parity symbols buy tt corrections; the receiver knows the code
pressures.resource_or_constraint: parity fraction; decoder arithmetic in a small field
pressures.failure_condition: more than tt errors -> uncorrected output passed through silently (this body) or flagged (Karn)
pressures.world_rewards: syndrome -> locator -> roots -> values
pressures.observable_consequence: corrected symbols vs injected errors (main's own demo)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: repetition
pressures.cheat_control: a decoder given the error positions (erasures) must correct 2tt of them; this body cannot use them -- the erasure capability is exactly what Karn added

pressures.condition: tasks of different urgency share one resource that must be held exclusively; the urgent task must complete within a bound; a watchdog treats lateness as failure
pressures.resource_or_constraint: one exclusive resource + CPU time ordered by priority
pressures.failure_condition: the urgent task waits on the resource while its holder is not permitted to run
pressures.world_punishes: a missed deadline (the lander reset itself repeatedly)
pressures.world_rewards: the urgent task getting the resource within its bound, regardless of who holds it
pressures.observable_consequence: a schedule with no enabled step (pan: invalid end state at depth 4)
pressures.vacuity_condition: a single priority level, or no shared resource
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: give everything the same priority (loses the timing guarantee the priorities exist for)
pressures.cheat_control: the CONTROL variant (renamed constants) still deadlocks; A1-A4 each remove the deadlock by removing a real precondition
pressures.cost_class: 12 reachable states; the failure is structural, not statistical
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: a spacecraft computer that shares a bus-data structure between a fast task and a slow task

pressures.condition: the database is a single ordinary file opened by any number of processes; there is no daemon to coordinate; the filesystem's guarantees are the weakest common denominator
pressures.failure_condition: corruption on power loss or concurrent access
pressures.world_punishes: assuming a coordinator; assuming atomic multi-sector writes
pressures.world_rewards: journal-then-write (or log-then-checkpoint) with lock state machines and checksums
pressures.observable_consequence: the pager's and WAL's crash-recovery paths; the record's smoke is only a query
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a server (forbidden by the design)
pressures.cheat_control: a build told the crash instants must recover every committed transaction; the smoke harness cannot show this -- a crash-injection world is required

pressures.condition: a query with n tables has n! loop orders times index choices; prepare must be fast; row counts are guesses unless ANALYZE ran
pressures.resource_or_constraint: prepare time; LogEst precision; optional statistics
pressures.failure_condition: a catastrophic plan (a full scan inside a loop)
pressures.world_rewards: a bounded beam over orders with logarithmic cost units and heuristics that survive missing statistics
pressures.observable_consequence: plan choice vs table sizes (EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: always nested loops in FROM order (correct, sometimes terrible)
pressures.cheat_control: a planner given true cardinalities must never lose to the estimated one by more than the beam's drop; if it does not beat LogEst estimates on skewed data, the world's data is not skewed

pressures.condition: each alignment is O(m n) cells; the hardware offers 16 parallel 8-bit operations but a serial dependency runs along both axes of the table
pressures.resource_or_constraint: SIMD width x lane precision; the vertical dependency
pressures.failure_condition: the scalar cost; or a layout whose dependencies serialise the lanes
pressures.world_punishes: lane-by-lane dependencies; scores that need more bits than a lane has
pressures.world_rewards: a layout where the dependency across lanes is rare (striping) and a cheap correction when it is not (lazy F)
pressures.observable_consequence: cells per second vs the scalar oracle (EMBOSS water, record)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: heuristic seed-and-extend (not the same optimum; the world must score exactness)
pressures.cheat_control: an aligner given the optimum in advance must report it at zero cost; if the world scores it equal to SSW on identical outputs without charging time, throughput is not measured
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: read mapping in sequencing pipelines

pressures.condition: 8-bit lanes clamp at 255; a high-scoring pair returns 255 with no error
pressures.failure_condition: a silently wrong optimum (record)
pressures.world_rewards: treating the saturation value as a detector and recomputing wider
pressures.observable_consequence: the record's entry point: a very high scoring pair
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: always use 16-bit lanes (half the throughput)
pressures.cheat_control: a pair whose true score is exactly 255 must still be recomputed; a world that never presents scores near the lane limit does not test this

pressures.source_evidence: the round structure; record entry point
pressures.condition: the same key must encrypt and decrypt; every output bit must depend on every input and key bit after few rounds; the implementation must be small enough for smart cards and fast on desktops
pressures.failure_condition: slow diffusion or a structural weakness
pressures.world_punishes: bit-level permutations (slow in software); structures that need many rounds
pressures.world_rewards: byte-oriented operations (table, rotation, small-field arithmetic) that diffuse in two rounds
pressures.observable_consequence: avalanche vs round count (not measured); the FIPS vectors
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a fixed random permutation table (2^128 entries; impossible)
pressures.cheat_control: the round-count sweep proposed for des-reference applies unchanged: a cipher with rounds reduced to 1 must FAIL an avalanche measure; if the world does not detect that, it is not measuring diffusion
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: confidentiality of 128-bit blocks (the DES replacement, 2001)

pressures.condition: messages are not 16 bytes; identical blocks must not encrypt identically; sometimes decryption code cannot be afforded
pressures.resource_or_constraint: code size on the decrypt side; an IV that must not repeat
pressures.failure_condition: ECB's block-pattern leakage; a repeated CTR nonce
pressures.world_rewards: chaining (CBC) or a counter keystream (CTR, which also deletes the inverse cipher)
pressures.observable_consequence: ciphertext of a repeated plaintext under each mode
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: none
pressures.cheat_control: N/A

pressures.source_evidence: the absence of an IR; tccrun.c
pressures.condition: C programs are to be compiled and executed in one command in the time an interpreter would take to start; code quality is secondary
pressures.failure_condition: a multi-pass pipeline too slow for -run
pressures.world_rewards: single-pass emission with just enough deferral (the value stack) to be correct
pressures.observable_consequence: compile time per line vs gcc; code speed of the output (worse)
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: an interpreter (slower to run; the world must charge run time too)
pressures.cheat_control: N/A
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: a small fast C compiler (Bellard)

pressures.condition: one pass means the code for a branch target does not exist when the branch is compiled
pressures.failure_condition: unresolvable forward references
pressures.world_rewards: threading the unresolved jumps through the code itself and patching at the label
pressures.observable_consequence: correct if/while/&&/|| code from one pass
pressures.vacuity_condition: a tree or a second pass
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: none in one pass

pressures.source_evidence: record pressure / failure condition; all three files
pressures.condition: N lines may request in any combination each clock; exactly zero or one may be granted; a line that keeps requesting must be served within a bounded number of cycles
pressures.resource_or_constraint: one shared resource; one decision per clock; bounded logic depth
pressures.failure_condition: starvation, or two grants at once (record)
pressures.world_punishes: fixed priority (starves high indices); unregistered state (glitches)
pressures.world_rewards: a priority origin that moves past the served requester
pressures.observable_consequence: the grant sequence under all-lines-high (rotation) and under one-line-always-high (others still served)
pressures.vacuity_condition: at most one requester at a time
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a free-running counter that grants line (t mod N) whether or not it requests (fair, wastes cycles; the world must reward utilisation)
pressures.cheat_control: an arbiter given the request schedule in advance must achieve zero idle grants and zero starvation; if the world scores the counter equally, it is not charging idle cycles
pressures.cost_class: CPU-scale (exhaustive: 2^N requests x N pointer states)
pressures.purpose_separated_from_pressure: PURPOSE: share a bus among masters

pressures.condition: the space of assignments is exponential; every conflict yields a clause worth remembering; memory is finite
pressures.failure_condition: MEM_OUT or TIME_OUT before an answer
pressures.world_punishes: keeping everything (memory) and forgetting everything (repeat the same conflicts)
pressures.world_rewards: keeping the recent and active clauses
pressures.observable_consequence: delete_unrelevant_clauses at each restart; MEM_OUT outcome exists
pressures.vacuity_condition: instances small enough to finish before the first restart
